searchText: Tim mentioned on Bankless that rinkeby is not moving to POS before the mainnet merge, but instead the three others… any reason why not rinkeby too? rinkeby is geth only so would be a lot of extra coordination for not as much value i think the maintainers were already looking for a reason to deprecrate it anyway in favor of say sepolia and this was a good time to do so Awesome, thanks for the answer 🙏
